meta.name: architecture-review
meta.description: Design or review software architecture using system context, container, component, runtime, deployment, data, API, integration, crosscutting concepts, and ADR artifacts. Use before large implementation, service-boundary changes, infrastructure changes, API or data contract changes, migrations, reliability work, security-sensitive design, or architecture artifacts `14-system-context.md` through `22-adr-index.md`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评审和设计软件架构,产出 ADR 决策记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 在大规模开发或系统改造前,需要梳理和确认架构方案
copy.tagline_en: Review and design software architecture, producing ADR decision records
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify and validate architecture before large-scale development or system changes

howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计或审查软件架构:先梳理系统边界、数据与接口,再产出系统上下文、组件视图、运行时场景、部署视图、数据模型、API 契约和 ADR 记录。
howto.when: 当你提出要开始大规模开发、改动服务边界、改基础设施、变更 API 或数据契约、做迁移或可靠性/安全相关工作等时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计这个新功能的架构,先画系统上下文图。
say.note: Claude 会从整体边界开始梳理系统结构。

say.text: 审查一下这次 API 契约变更的风险点。
say.note: 它会检查跨边界影响并列出需决策的项。

say.text: 为这次数据库迁移写一份 ADR。
say.note: Claude 会记录背景、方案与权衡。

howto.what_en: Claude will help design or review software architecture: it maps boundaries, data, and interfaces, then produces system context, container/component views, runtime scenarios, deployment view, data model, API contracts, and ADR artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start large implementation, change service boundaries or infrastructure, alter API/data contracts, or do migration, reliability, or security-sensitive work.

say_en.text: Help me design the architecture for this feature; start with a system context diagram.
say_en.note: Claude will clarify the system boundary first.

say_en.text: Review the risks of this API contract change.
say_en.note: It checks cross-boundary impact and lists decisions.

say_en.text: Write an ADR for this database migration.
say_en.note: Claude records context, options, and tradeoffs.
